title: 第3章 灵源现仙途开第4章 法术选择
slug: 灵源仙途我养的灵兽太懂感恩了
content_zh:
不知不觉已是日上三竿，毒辣辣的太阳从竹林的缝隙里钻了下来。
顾安二人正在给灵鸡梳理羽毛，这是每天都要做的任务。
只因彩羽鸡生性好动，经常将羽毛弄的凌乱，又爱干净，看到不整齐的羽毛便要啄下来，若是不去梳理，只消几天，就光的光，秃的秃。
这时，远处飞来一片绿叶，顾安羡慕的看了过去。
这空行叶虽说只是下品法器，但飞行法器本就贵，价格抵得上寻常中品法器。
顾安除了从黑石城来青元宗时坐过一回灵舟，还没上过天呢。
每年这个时候，都会有宗门修士前来取灵鸡，然后送往青云楼。
往年顾安也见过两回这空行叶法器，想来今年还是王执事前来。
片刻后，绿叶法器飞近，从上面跃下一中年修士，笑着向刘管事打招呼。
“刘兄，近来可好？”
“好得很哪，吃好喝好，便是岁月静好。”
刘管事摇头晃脑，神情惬意。
一番寒暄后，方才提到正事。
“王老弟，不知今年宗门要多少只灵鸡啊？”
“最近宗门可不安稳，北方云雾山脉妖乱频发，已有临近坊市被妖兽攻破，掌门下令云烟坊市，云湖坊市的青云楼撤回。”
“今年的灵鸡需要的数量也有减少，你们翠竹峰的灵鸡场便取一百二十只吧，若是不够，我再去其他峰取。”
“那自然好，王老弟今日可要陪我喝上几杯，刚巧峰顶的贺老头送了我两坛翠竹蛇酒，那味道，可美得很！”
“哈哈，那就却之不恭了。”
顾安跟在两人后面，听着二人交谈，试图分析一些有用信息。
刘管事和这王师兄年轻时交好，因而每次交接灵鸡时不会为难，反而提供诸多便利。

而刘管事投桃报李，也给王执事不少油水。
宗门对此心知肚明，水至清则无鱼，也不必管！
反正宗门提供的灵谷灵麸就那么多，你有本事多养，那是你的本事，只要宗门任务不出差错就可。
可以说是交够宗门的，剩下都是自己的。
刘管事引着王执事前往他的小院，刘管事的住处便在这灵鸡场的小院。
这小院不比顾安二人的小院大多少，可精致程度远超。
小院不大，却极清幽。
一池幽水映天光，中有两尾灵鱼曳尾，搅碎半池云影。
池畔立一六角小亭，飞檐斗拱如仙鹤展翅，亭中一小桌，四石凳，端的是大方雅致。
亭侧是一丛翠竹，竿竿青玉，叶叶生凉，风来飒飒，竹影婆娑。
“顾安、张松，你二人去杀两只彩羽鸡来，顾安去东厨料理，张松你打下手。”
刘管事对二人吩咐道。
顾安家中是开酒楼的，父母经常带着他下厨，想来是要他以后继承家业。
content_en:
Unconsciously, it was already three o'clock in the sky, and the scorching sun came down through the gaps in the bamboo forest.
Gu An and his two men were combing the feathers of the rooster, which was a daily task.
Because colorful feather chickens are active by nature, they often mess up their feathers, and they love to keep their feathers clean. They will peck out the uneven feathers when they see them. If they don't comb them, they will be completely bald in just a few days.
At this time, a piece of green leaf flew in the distance, and Gu An looked at it with envy.
Although this Dakiniye is only a low-grade magic weapon, the flying magic weapon is expensive, and the price is equivalent to an ordinary mid-grade magic weapon.
Gu An has never been to heaven except for taking a trip on the spirit boat when he came to Qingyuan Sect from Black Rock City.
Every year at this time, monks from the sect would come to pick up the spiritual chicken and then send it to Qingyun Tower.
In previous years, Gu An had seen this Dakiniye magic weapon twice, and I think it was Deacon Wang who came here this year.
After a moment, the Green Leaf Magical Artifact flew closer, and a middle-aged monk jumped out from above and greeted Manager Liu with a smile.
"Brother Liu, how are you doing lately?"
"It's very good. Eat well and drink well, and the years will be peaceful."
Manager Liu shook his head, looking satisfied.
After some pleasantries, we got down to business.
"Brother Wang, I wonder how many spiritual chickens the sect needs this year?"
"The sect has not been stable recently. Monster chaos has occurred frequently in the Yunwu Mountains in the north. The neighboring cities have been attacked by monsters. The leader ordered the Qingyun Tower in Yunyanfang City and Yunhufang City to withdraw."
"The number of spiritual chickens needed this year has also been reduced. Your spiritual chicken farm at Cuizhu Peak will take one hundred and twenty. If it is not enough, I will go to other peaks to get them."
"Of course that's good. Brother Wang wants to have a few drinks with me today. It just so happens that Old Man He from the top of the mountain gave me two jars of bamboo snake wine. The taste is so beautiful!"
"Haha, that would be disrespectful."
Gu An followed the two men, listening to their conversation and trying to analyze some useful information.
Manager Liu had a good relationship with Senior Brother Wang when they were young, so every time he handed over the soul chicken, he would not be embarrassed, but would provide many conveniences.
Manager Liu reciprocated the favor and gave Deacon Wang a lot of favors.
The sect is well aware of this. If the water is clear, there will be no fish, so there is no need to care!
Anyway, there are only so many spiritual grains and spiritual bran provided by the sect. If you have the ability to raise more, that is your ability, as long as the sect does not make mistakes in its tasks.
It can be said that if you have enough friends with the sect, the rest is yours.
Manager Liu led Deacon Wang to his small courtyard. Manager Liu's residence was in the small courtyard of Lingji Farm.
This small courtyard is not much larger than Gu An and his wife's small courtyard, but it is far more exquisite.
The courtyard is not big, but it is very quiet.
A pool of quiet water reflects the skylight, and there are two spiritual fish dragging their tails in it, shattering the cloud shadows in half of the pool.
There is a small hexagonal pavilion beside the pool, with cornices and brackets like a crane spreading its wings. There is a small table and four stone benches in the pavilion, which are generous and elegant.
On the side of the pavilion is a clump of green bamboo with green jade poles. The leaves are cool, the wind rustles, and the bamboo shadows dance.
"Gu An, Zhang Song, you two go kill two colorful chickens. Gu An goes to the east kitchen to cook. Zhang Song, you can help."
Manager Liu ordered the two of them.
Gu An's family ran a restaurant, and his parents often took him to cook, presumably because they wanted him to inherit the family business in the future.
